name: Progress
description: How far something has got, as a bar or a ring, with or without a known end.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the track, on the left.

props.name: value
props.description: How far it has got. Changes move the fill with a spring.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: There is no known end: a soft band of water sweeps along the track.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the formatted value above the track, on the right. Hidden while indeterminate.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fill colour: water, or a status colour for a bar that reports health, such as usage nearing a limit.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ProgressBar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. The ring has no visible label.

props.name: value
props.description: How far it has got. The arc fills clockwise from the top.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: There is no known end: an arc turns around the ring.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value in the middle. Only the large ring has room for it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The arc is currentColor, water by default. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ProgressBar.
